programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT S2
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY START A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! From building BU INAH'S dream food stall, dealing with the lively antics of their neighbor CEU KOKOM, to PAK SOMAT'S efforts to become an online motorcycle taxi driver for his family. A heartwarming story filled with laughter and moral lessons, suitable for all ages.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO CYBERSPACE ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: While Pororo and his friends are having fun playing, they suddenly get pulled into the cyber world! Now, they must become superheroes to rescue Princess Petty from the villain's captivity and find their way back home.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. THE STORY FOCUS ON THE FRIENDSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT BRINGING BY THEIR JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF POKEMON.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.desc: After six years of keeping our malls safe, Paul Blart has earned a well-deserved vacation. He heads to Las Vegas with his teenage daughter before she heads off to college. But safety never takes a holiday and when duty calls, Blart answers.

programme.title: Sex Tape (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: A married couple wake up to discover that the sex tape they made the evening before has gone missing, leading to a frantic search for its whereabouts.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: Safer At Home
programme.desc: Two years into the pandemic, a group of friends throw a wild online party. After taking ecstasy, things go terribly wrong and the safety of their homes becomes more terrifying than the raging chaos outside.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: When Christian, an LA trust-fund kid with casual ties to Hollywood, learns of a secret affair between Tara and Ryan, he spirals out of control, and his cruel mind games escalate into an act of bloody violence.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Follows a dog who is a master escape artist, who must team up with his puppy pals to prevent their block from being robbed.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: After being stabbed in the heart by ruthless home invaders, a man is left for dead. Now weak, outnumbered, and knife sticking from his chest, he attempts to do the impossible: save his wife from these murderers before he bleeds to death.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth arrives with her brilliant scientist husband Henry to his magnificent estate. Henry explains that everything in his world now belongs to her, all except for a locked-off room he forbids her from entering.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Detachment
programme.desc: A substitute teacher who drifts from classroom to classroom finds a connection to the students and teachers during his latest assignment.

programme.title: Wunderland
programme.desc: Lt. Cappa and his American infantry platoon are ordered to defend a vital road junction against a German offensive in the Battle of the Bulge. Despite difficult winter conditions, they must hold their position to stop the German advance.

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: The Killing Of K. Chamberlain
programme.desc: The true story of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

programme.title: Shock And Awe
programme.desc: A group of journalists of the Knight-Ridder covering President George W. Bush's planned invasion of Iraq in 2003 are skeptical of the President's claim that Saddam Hussein has 'weapons of mass destruction.'

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: When a young mother is barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex-boyfriend, she must use ingenuity to protect her two small children from escalating danger while finding an escape.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: One miraculous day in rural Wisconsin the deceased rise from their graves, yet appear and act unchanged. And now it is up to Officer and single mother Dana Cypress to solve a murder case where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Gunfight At Dry River
programme.desc: The US-Mexican border in 1888. In Dry River, a desert town debilitated by drought, a promise of gold will bring hope, love, and death in equal measure.

programme.title: Force Of Execution
programme.desc: A crime boss who runs a southwestern town needs the help of his former hit-man to deal with a new threat to his empire.

programme.title: After We Fell
programme.desc: Just as Tessa makes the biggest decision of her life, everything changes. Revelations about her family, and then Hardin's, throw everything they knew before in doubt and makes their future together more difficult.

programme.title: The Super
programme.desc: A man becomes the superintendent of a large New York City apartment building where people mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: American Rider

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens has a crush on Nina Pennington. They form a friendship and take a rock'n'roll journey together while Nina deals with her overbearing boyfriend Kevin.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: During the last days of the Great War, a group of U.S. soldiers are sent behind enemy lines to rescue a lost platoon.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: When his mother dies, scandal-ridden ex-Olympian John Wright returns to a hometown that has not forgiven him.

programme.title: Murder Of N. Brown Simpson

programme.title: Sacrifice
programme.desc: An undercover cop inadvertently gets involved in a dangerous heroin ring when a young defector of the drug trade leaves his five year-old sister in his care.

programme.title: Curi-Curi Kesempatan
programme.desc: The story of Andy and Martin who are tricked by Robin. They both has to disguise as women and sneak into a group of celebrities who are going on tour in order to escape.

programme.title: Giliran Saya Mana
programme.desc: A young couple decided to elope because the woman's parents only want their child to marry a rich person. The problem started when they decided to pretend to be rich and borrowed a luxury house from their friend.

programme.title: Skandal
programme.desc: Mischa, who bored with her marriage, find her life changes when she sees Vincent, her former lover. But he is so possessive that he insists on continuing the relationship and starts to threaten Mischa's family.

programme.title: Dear Jo: Almost Is Never Enough
programme.desc: After the tragic death of Maura, Ella and Joshua's lives are shattered as Ella carries Maura's child, navigating grief, parenthood, and unexpected challenges.

She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life

We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: L'ABÎME
programme.desc: L'Abîme follows Laurent Lacaze, whose life is shattered when his wife Elsa vanishes without a trace. While the police search for answers, they uncover evidence that Elsa is not the woman everyone believed her to be. Forced to confront the possibility that his wife has lived under a false identity, Laurent embarks on a desperate quest to uncover her past. As buried secrets emerge and new threats arise, the investigation reveals a complex conspiracy that puts both Laurent and their daughter in grave danger. Combining psychological suspense with family drama, the series keeps viewers guessing until the very end.

programme.desc: Anggita suddenly proposes a new program for her student organization in order to help her entering her dream university. Meanwhile, The Great Kisser, a band consisting of Javit, Mario, and Robert, pursue a performance stage before they graduate high school.

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E2
programme.desc: Anggita starts a petition to persuade Doglas, the school headmaster, to give her the greenlight for the school art festival. Javit, who feels that Anggita has stolen his festival idea, starts his own petition as well. Who is going to end up leading the festival? Anggita or Javit?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E3
programme.desc: Tebes school art festival committee must contract a sponsor within a week or they cant continue with the event. Javit has an idea to produce a proposal video to make them stand out. Will they get a sponsor before the deadline?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E4
programme.desc: The program sponsor is requesting to replace Grace with Dini for the art festival ambassador. Grace loses her confiedence and very disappointed since Anggita, her best friend, take the festival a priority more than their friendship. Can Grace gain her confidence back even though shes no longer the festival ambassador?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E5
programme.desc: The start of festival is getting closer. Anggita pressures the committee to work harder. Javit tries to make Anggita have fun by asking her out, but it only brings back painful memories. Will Anggita gain back the trust of her committee and make peace with her past?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E6
programme.desc: The try out results of all committee are failing. They need to improve their grades if they want the festival continued. Anggita hesistanly postpone the preparation of festival and ask her friends to study harder, especially Javit who has the worst grade. Will they be able to improve their grade and make the festival happening?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E7
programme.desc: Javit is busy with his music. Robert is in trouble with his debt. Whereas Mario is anxious because of Dini's acts. All of this creates frictions for their friendship. Will The Great kisser survive?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E8
programme.desc: Dinis nude photo causes an uproar at school and social media. As a result, all school activities are frozen, including the art festival. Even the sponsor withdraws their sponsorship. Anggita is anxious and tries to save the festival. Can it be saved? What about Dinis fate?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E9
programme.desc: The school pressures Doglas to expel Dini. The art festival committee still try to continue the festival and get Dini back to school. Dini herself avoids everyone, especially Mario. Can the committee fights for Dinis rights and make the festival happening?

programme.title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah: The Series S1 E10
programme.desc: The art festival is finally here. The Great Kisser will not go on stage due to Javits disappearance. Meanwhile, the Kapak Biru gang want to revenge on the Tebe festival. Will there be another riot in Tebe?

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E1
programme.desc: Naya realized that her high school days were not as exciting as most other high school teenagers were. While she was seeing Jetta on the iPad with a smile, suddenly a shooting star appeared in the sky. Naya prays that her wish to be Jetta's girlfriend can be a realilty and to accompany her days, and also to be her partner to attend prom party later.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E2
programme.desc: Naya woke up and screamed hysterically because she saw the real Jetta lying next to her, smiling sweetly and greeting her. Naya panicked and tried to think clearly about what happened last night, 'Was my wish last night really happening?'. Since then, Jetta always appears and follows Naya wherever she goes and it makes her school friends suspicious.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E3
programme.desc: Naya asked for Reno's help to hide Jetta in his house. She also prayed to God that Jetta would return to his world since she didn't want to make the situation more complicated. However, Naya couldn't stop herself thinking about Jetta, so he was appeared in her room. She shouted loudly, making her parent come to her room. Will they find out about Jetta?

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E4
programme.desc: Naya was nervous when Queena asked her to introduce her to Jetta. While she was thinking about Jetta, he suddenly appeared and made the canteen's atmosphere lively. At the same time, Majja came and he asked Jetta to leave. There was almost a quarrel, and Queena was furious so that she asked Majja to end their relationship.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E5
programme.desc: Naya's days became different after Jetta arrived. Now Naya can hang out at the mall and spend time with Jetta. At school, Naya is also happy because she can feel friendship with her girl gang, Queena. Naya is starting to experience the excitement of high school as she expected.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E6
programme.desc: The fight with Reno makes Naya sad. Jetta comforted Naya and she was even sadder when she found out that her tryout score was bad. Queena goes to Naya's house and tries to cure her sadness. At this moment, Queena saw Naya's journal and found out about Naya's lies about Jetta.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E7
programme.desc: For the first time, Naya ran away from home and stayed overnight at Queena's residence. However, Keyla trapped her and forced Naya to undress and smoke. Icha secretly recorded Naya's actions, while Queena remained silent. Naya's mother was extremely angry and made her cry in fear.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E8
programme.desc: Reno showed a viral Tiktok video of Naya smoking in her room wearing only a bra. Naya fell silent, cried, and almost fainted. The school also called Naya and her Mother to the Guidance Counseling room to confirm the video.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E9
programme.desc: Naya was sick, at that time she felt her life was over. That night the shooting star happened again, Naya cried. He regretted his ridiculous request for Jetta to come true, but instead it turned everything into a mess. programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E10

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, who recently broke up with Jessica, feels there is no point in working hard as a magazine photographer. In the midst of his mental turmoil, Razi meets Jane who offers Razi a side job as a paparazzi. Eventually he accepted the offer, although at first he wanted to withdraw because the risk was too dangerous. Razi then traveled to Yogyakarta with Jane. Formerly, he wanted to help Jane meet a witch to do something on Jane's father's mistress. But the two of them unexpectedly experience an exciting and tense adventure being held hostage by the heretical sect of the Kamilia Divine Kingdom in Gunung Kidul. As a result of being together in the suffering situation, the seeds of love between Razi and Jane start to grow.
